ranked.title: The Closure Proposer — reduced to a self-solvation-gated law-vs-compensation adjudicator
ranked.why_it_ranks_here: It is the ONLY candidate whose both critique lenses agree is genuinely constructive AND not-rank-in-disguise (reduces_to_rank=false, twice), and the only one with an impact ceiling rated 'strong-domain'. The full amortized-SBI apparatus is scooped (Bayesian-SR posteriors, COSMO-SAC-ML), but both reviewers independently converge on the SAME surviving, non-scooped kernel: use single-component / self-solvation corroboration as the pre-registered acceptance gate. That gate escapes rank (it is a transfer/function-space test, never a spectrum), escapes scooping (no distillation or Bayesian-SR competitor uses it), is cheap via the repo's aux-stream self-solvent rows, and IS the compass verbatim. It ranks first because it is the strongest instantiation of 'real physics vs compensating imitation' that survives both traps.
ranked.novel_sliver_one_line: Self-solvation is the one axis a matched-capacity black-box residual compensator structurally cannot cheat (never fit there, no signal there), so requiring a constructed closed-form term to corroborate it discriminates discovered law from imitation where every scooped competitor is blind.
ranked.ceiling: strong-domain if a transferable term is found; realistically a reusable law-vs-compensation instrument plus an honest negative (rank-1 predicts no cheap missing law)
ranked.cheapest_kill_test: Fit a closed-form σ-profile-functional correction on TRAIN solvent systems, then check whether a matched-capacity black-box MLP correction matches it on held-out self-solvation/single-component data; if the black-box is NOT structurally blind there (matches the physics term), the discriminator is dead. Precede with a planted-dsp-term positive control on synthetic data — if the instrument can't separate planted-term from black-box, stop before touching real data.

ranked.title: The Closure Counterfactual Engine
ranked.why_it_ranks_here: Second because it is genuinely generative and does NOT reduce to rank (both lenses agree), and its deliverable is a produced object (a de-imitated model), not a measurement. But it is scooped as physics-teacher / Sobolev-Jacobian distillation, its marquee know-vs-imitate test is circular (TGNNSolv literally CONTAINS the CosmoSacLayer, so 'physics beats black-box on closure counterfactuals' is baked in), and 'closure-exact' inherits COSMO-SAC's 0.5–1 log bias, so 'make it real' really means 'make it closure-biased'. Ceiling is modest-domain. It sits below #1 because its surviving contribution collapses to an augmentation ablation.
ranked.novel_sliver_one_line: The invariance-decoder is a validated thermodynamic closure, so manufactured counterfactual pairs are exact LABELS rather than a learned decoder's opinion — but this is the standard COSMO-teacher paradigm and adds little over direct label distillation.
ranked.cheapest_kill_test: Score trained DirectGNN vs TGNNSolv on the manufactured counterfactual pairs at extrapolative conditions; if DirectGNN reproduces the closure counterfactuals as well as the physics model, there is no imitation gap to expose or cure — null result (and note the physics-model win is confounded by it containing the closure).

ranked.title: Closure-Clamped Flows
ranked.why_it_ranks_here: Cleanest, most feasible artifact (laptop-only), and one lens rated it genuinely generative/non-trivial. But it reduces to rank where it is load-bearing: the (u,v) split is Constantine active subspaces and the closed-form clamp is a rank-1 special case of already-published Physics-Constrained Flow Matching's Gauss-Newton projection. Its one decisive-and-cheap test (exactness) is a construction tautology; its genuinely generative question (fibre realizability) is undecidable because the validity oracle is the flow's OWN density and there is no σ-profile→molecule inverse — so 'molecular design freedom' stays aspirational. Modest-domain.
ranked.novel_sliver_one_line: Rank-1 makes the property-conditioning projection closed-form and hyperparameter-free — a modest engineering delta over generic equality-constrained flows, plus a realizability characterization that is dimension-of-a-set measurement in a generative costume.
ranked.cheapest_kill_test: Sample the 49-D iso-γ fibre at a fixed target and measure the in-distribution-valid fraction; if it collapses to effectively 0–1 dimensions the 'design freedom' is an artifact — but note the oracle is circular, so even a 'pass' does not certify real molecules.

ranked.title: Compression Recovers the Knob (minimal σ-profile generator)
ranked.why_it_ranks_here: Its only non-rank, non-trivial claim is the emergence gate (MDL compression spontaneously spends one latent coordinate on the closure axis). Both lenses judge that this is (a) the burned disentanglement/identifiability ground in disguise, (b) already published for physical generative factors, and (c) likely to FAIL for a repo-grounded reason: rank-1 sensitivity is HB-bin-localized (~2 bins) while the dominant variance across VT-2005 σ-profiles is broad polarity — a compression-optimal code spends its top coordinates elsewhere. Fail → active subspaces; pass → known β-VAE dominant-axis alignment. Either branch is disqualified or scooped.
ranked.novel_sliver_one_line: The disentangling axis is read exactly off a real closure Jacobian rather than learned/assumed — but the control/diversity split is active subspaces and the emergence law is a spectral-alignment measurement.
ranked.cheapest_kill_test: Step A: estimate intrinsic dimension of the 1432 VT-2005 σ-profiles (PCA scree + TwoNN); if ≳20 the compression story is dead outright. Then fix the top-loading latent coordinate vs a random one and compare lnγ spread under the exact closure; if they match, compression did not force the physics knob to emerge.

ranked.title: The Isopotential Design Operator

ranked.title: Physics-Certified Iso-Property Design Manifolds
ranked.why_it_ranks_here: Worst — the only candidate both lenses vote DROP/DROP. The flagship 'certified iso-property REAL molecules' is unsound exactly where it claims exactness: certification to 1e-6 holds only for abstract free σ-vectors, and snapping to the nearest real VT-2005 molecule breaks it (the real molecule's true γ ≠ y*). You get certified-but-unphysical OR real-but-uncertified, never both. The retraction walk is textbook predictor-corrector continuation (active subspaces + trivial many-to-one), and exhaustive exact-closure library filtering dominates the deliverable. Scooped by 'Freedom of Design' (Chem Sci 2023).
ranked.novel_sliver_one_line: The single salvageable kernel is a discovered constant-γ trade-off LAW (H-bond-donor vs nonpolar σ-area exchange rate) validated against real iso-γ molecules — an equation-of-a-rule claim, not a certified generator — but must be differentiated from 'Freedom of Design' first.
ranked.cheapest_kill_test: Snap each generated on-manifold profile to its nearest VT-2005 molecule and re-evaluate true γ through the closure; the deviation from y* shows certification evaporates, and counting real iso-property molecules found by plain library filtering vs the walk shows the machinery adds nothing.

synthesis.top_pick: The Closure Proposer, stripped to its surviving kernel: a self-solvation / single-component-corroboration gate used as a law-vs-compensation adjudicator for a constructed closed-form COSMO-SAC missing-term. Ship the DISCRIMINATOR (validated on a planted-term positive control), not a bet that a new transferable law exists.
synthesis.honest_meta: Brutal truth: the pure-generative 'design-freedom' framing you were hoping might sign-flip the dead result is itself dead. Candidates 1, 2, 4, and 6 all put the closure Jacobian's null space at the load-bearing center, and every one collapses to Constantine active subspaces plus the trivial many-to-one ('a scalar map has a gradient and a codim-1 level set') — the exact burned ground, now additionally scooped by Physics-Constrained Flow Matching (the closed-form clamp) and COSMO-CAMD (the solvent families). The '49 dims of design freedom' is one sentence away from 'the forward map is many-to-one,' and no reviewer let it get further. The two candidates that genuinely ESCAPE rank (3 and 5) do so by being constructive-not-spectral — but they escape into a different crowded room: physics-teacher / Sobolev-Jacobian distillation (3) and Bayesian symbolic regression + COSMO-SAC-ML (5). So on the axes you set, nothing survives fully clean.\n\nBUT there is one real, nameable seed, and I won't inflate it: the self-solvation / single-component corroboration gate that BOTH critics of candidate 5 independently converged on as the fold-in. It is the only sliver that clears rank AND scooping AND triviality at once, because it is a genuinely uncommon discriminator — a matched-capacity black-box residual compensator is structurally BLIND on self-solvation (it was never fit there and has no signal there), so demanding a constructed closed-form term predict the right single-component sign/magnitude separates 'learned the law' from 'soaked residuals into the null space' in a way no scooped competitor can pass. That is your compass, exactly, made operational and cheap (the repo already has the self-solvent aux-stream). The honest caveat that keeps you grounded: the measured rank-1 fact predicts the GENERATIVE payoff is probably null — there is likely no cheaply-groundable missing term to discover — so the durable deliverable is the ADJUDICATION INSTRUMENT plus an honest negative, not a splashy new generator. That is a real, publishable, un-scooped contribution of the measurement-instrument kind you are actually good at; it is not the triumphant physics-derived generative controller the seed dreamed of. Build the discriminator, prove it works on a planted term, then let the real data deliver whatever verdict it delivers.

direction.title: The Isopotential Design Operator: physics-exact, certified disentangled control of thermodynamic activity, benchmarked against learned controllers
direction.one_liner: Turn the fatal rank-1 closure into a generator that ships real iso-activity solvent families plus a scalar knob with a per-molecule analytic error certificate no learned controller can match -- and stake the whole claim on whether exact LOCAL closure control actually beats a learned GLOBAL direction.
direction.the_idea:
The differentiable COSMO-SAC in-repo (CosmoSacLayer.ln_gamma_2) is an exact, autodiffable map g: sigma-profile (52-dim) -> ln gamma. At any real molecule's sigma-profile s0, autodiff gives the exact Jacobian row j = d ln gamma / d s and Hessian-vector products for free. This defines, per-molecule and in closed form, a coordinate split: a scalar CONTROL knob u along j (moving the target property by a certified amount) and a ~51-dim DIVERSITY subspace orthogonal to j (moving molecular identity while changing ln gamma by a certified |delta| <= eps, with eps bounded by the closure Hessian along the step -- both computed by autodiff, not estimated from data).

The constructive deliverable is an "isopotential design operator": given a seed solvent and a requested shift Delta(ln gamma), it (a) takes the exact control step with a curvature correction, (b) walks the diversity subspace to spread out, and (c) PROJECTS the resulting sigma-profiles onto the manifold of REAL molecules by retrieval/local projection over the VT-2005 library (results/sigma_profile_artifact/sigma_profiles.csv, ~2000 real compounds) -- sidestepping the unsolved sigma-profile-to-molecule inverse problem entirely. Output: an ordered FAMILY of real, existing solvents with matched dissolving power for the solute, spanning secondary axes (bp, molar volume, tox proxy), plus one exact knob to slide the whole family's activity by a certified Delta. Every produced member is re-scored by the same COSMO-SAC, so on-target accuracy and off-target invariance are measured on the artifact, not assumed.

The load-bearing scientific claim is a head-to-head: an EXACT, LOCAL, per-molecule closure step delivers lower on-target error and lower off-target leakage than a LEARNED GLOBAL control direction (gradient of a fitted surrogate; a beta-VAE/PCA "activity axis"), AND the gap is explained by closure nonlinearity (locality + curvature). The certificate -- a per-molecule analytic error bar on the controlled property -- is the thing no amortized generator (GFlowNet, conditional flow, PI-VAE) can produce.
direction.why_generative_not_diagnostic: The deliverable is a produced artifact and a controller, and every reported number is a generative-fidelity quantity, never a spectrum. Concretely we ship: (1) real iso-activity solvent families (a designed set of existing molecules); (2) a control interface with a certified knob u -> Delta(ln gamma); (3) a benchmark table of on-target achieved-vs-requested Delta, off-target leakage into a preserved property, and family diversity/validity. Nowhere do we report a rank, an identifiable-dimension, a singular-value cutoff, or a Jacobian spectrum as a result. The Jacobian is the ENGINE that parameterizes the generator; success is judged by whether the generated molecules exist, hit the requested property, and preserve what they were meant to preserve -- functional properties of the artifact. Contrast the two dead programs: those asked "is the latent real / how many dims are identifiable" (measurement). This asks "here are 20 real solvents I built to a spec, do they meet it, and does my exact controller beat a learned one at building them" (construction + falsifiable performance).
direction.constructive_artifact: A physics-exact isopotential design operator: input = (solute, seed solvent, requested Delta ln gamma); output = an ordered family of REAL VT-2005 solvents at the target activity spanning chosen secondary axes, each carrying an autodiff-computed error certificate on the controlled property and a curvature-bounded invariance guarantee on the preserved property. Implementation is a thin wrapper over the existing differentiable CosmoSacLayer (autodiff for j and Hessian-vector products) + the VT-2005 retrieval/projection step; no training, no GPU for the core. Byproduct: a reusable "certified control" benchmark for thermodynamic closures that any learned generator can be dropped into.
direction.novel_sliver_vs_scooped:
HONEST prior art. (1) GFlowNets / TacoGFN / conditional GFlowNets (arXiv 2310.03223, 2409.09702): diverse molecules at a target reward -- the goal "diverse molecules at fixed property" is fully scooped; I must NOT claim it. (2) Physics-informed guided disentanglement (arXiv 2107.14229), physics-informed VAEs (2506.13658), disentangled repr. for parametric PDEs (2410.02136): "physics-informed disentanglement for controllable generation" as a phrase and program is taken -- but they use physics as a soft renderer/guide or insert physics latents with regularization; the control axis is still learned and approximate. (3) Null-space inverse design (NPN, arXiv 2510.01608; "manifold of designs satisfying the same target" is explicitly standard): null-space = design freedom is known, in the observation space of a linear/learned operator. (4) Active subspaces for generative molecular design (arXiv 2405.00202) + the project's own measured rank-1 fact = the row-space/active-subspace split is NOT novel. (5) Sethna/Transtrum sloppy models, Constantine active subspaces: the decomposition itself is old.

The EXACT remaining sliver, after all of the above: nobody uses the analytic Jacobian of a VALIDATED, differentiable thermodynamic closure to attach a PER-MOLECULE, CLOSED-FORM ERROR CERTIFICATE to a controlled generative step, and nobody couples the closure's null space to the mismatch between the closure's input space (sigma-profile) and the realizable-molecule manifold to construct CERTIFIED-INVARIANT families of REAL molecules. And the falsifiable comparison -- does an exact LOCAL closure step beat a learned GLOBAL control direction, and is any gap attributable to closure curvature -- has not been run for a chemical closure. The novelty is the certificate + the realizability-coupled construction + the head-to-head, explicitly NOT the existence of a null space.
direction.minimal_viable_experiment: CPU-only, an afternoon, reusing CosmoSacLayer + VT-2005. (1) Fix a solute; for N~2000 real solvent sigma-profiles compute ln gamma and, by autodiff, the exact control direction j and curvature along j. (2) Physics controller: knob = j-hat with curvature-corrected step; diversity basis = complement. (3) Learned baselines: gradient of a fitted surrogate ln gamma ~ f(sigma) (linear + small MLP), and a PCA/beta-VAE "activity axis" over sigma-profiles. (4) For requested targets Delta in {+/-0.5, +/-1.0}: take each controller's step, PROJECT to nearest real VT-2005 molecules, recompute TRUE ln gamma with COSMO-SAC. (5) Metrics on the produced families: on-target error |achieved - requested Delta|; off-target leakage = drift in a property meant to be preserved when walking the diversity subspace (e.g., ln gamma of the same solvent for a DIFFERENT reference solute, or molar volume); family diversity (pairwise sigma distance / distinct scaffolds). FALSIFICATION: the direction is DEAD if (a) the physics controller does not beat both learned controllers on on-target error at matched diversity beyond noise, OR (b) cosine(learned gradient, j) > 0.98 almost everywhere -- i.e. ln gamma(sigma) is effectively globally linear, curvature is irrelevant, and the analytic Jacobian buys nothing a global surrogate can't learn.
direction.biggest_risk: It secretly reduces to "we used the analytic gradient instead of a learned one." If ln gamma(sigma) is close to globally linear, the learned global control direction coincides with the exact local Jacobian (cosine -> 1), off-target leakage is identical, and the physics advantage collapses -- leaving active-subspaces + null-space-inverse-design (both real prior art) with only the certificate as genuinely new, which is a methods note, not a program. Second risk: the artifact is a SELECTOR over a fixed 2000-molecule library, not a de-novo molecular generator, so it looks weak next to GFlowNet/diffusion generators; the certified-invariance story only bites for reviewers who value guarantees over novelty of molecules. Third risk: the whole "1 control + 51 diversity" framing is one sentence away from the trivial "the forward map is many-to-one" -- the paper survives ONLY if the reported result is generative fidelity + certificate + the curvature-explains-the-gap finding, and dies the moment it leans on the subspace dimension as the contribution. The MVE's clause (b) is designed to kill it fast if the curvature gap isn't real.

critiques.lens: IS IT REALLY GENERATIVE, OR RANK IN DISGUISE?
critiques.scooping_justification: The engine is exactly the crowded neighborhood the two dead programs died in. (1) arXiv 2405.00202 "Leveraging Active Subspaces ... for Molecular Design" already fuses Constantine active subspaces (= the Jacobian row-space/null-space split) with generative molecular design — the "control subspace + diversity subspace derived from a gradient operator" is that paper's premise, not a new sliver. (2) Differentiable thermodynamic modeling (Guan, arXiv 2102.10705; Acta Mater. 2021) already establishes autodiff Jacobians of thermodynamic observables w.r.t. model inputs — the "exact analytic Jacobian of a validated differentiable closure" is prior art, not novel. (3) Null-space inverse design (NPN, cited by the proposal) already frames the null space as design freedom over the same-target manifold. (4) Controllable molecular generation at a target property (GFlowNets, CoMole arXiv 2605.15354, ORGANIC) owns "diverse real molecules at fixed property." The only genuinely unpublished morsel — a per-molecule Taylor/Lipschitz remainder bound attached to a controlled step — is standard numerical analysis (a curvature-bounded remainder), a methods footnote, and it sits atop, not outside, this stack. There is no program-sized escape.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The realizability projection self-destructs the whole apparatus. To dodge the σ-profile→molecule inverse problem, the operator SELECTS over the ~1432 real VT-2005 σ-profiles, and it RE-SCORES every produced member with exact COSMO-SAC. But an enumerable 1432-element library means brute-force exact evaluation of ln γ for the entire library (literally step 1 of the MVE) dominates any local Jacobian controller — enumeration beats local optimization on a small discrete set, exactly and cheaply — and because you re-score with the exact model, the per-molecule analytic certificate is redundant (you already hold ground truth). The certificate/controller only buy anything for a NON-enumerable amortized de-novo generator that CANNOT re-score — which the realizability coupling explicitly forecloses. Strip the generative costume and what remains is: the Jacobian row-space/null-space (active-subspace) decomposition, plus the tautology that the exact gradient of a known differentiable model beats a learned surrogate gradient of that same model whenever the model is nonlinear. The learned baseline is a strawman (nobody with a differentiable COSMO-SAC would fit a β-VAE activity axis), so the "head-to-head" has a predetermined winner and no scientific content. This is rank-in-disguise: the load-bearing object is the Jacobian null space; the "20 real solvents" wrapper is cosmetic.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Move to a regime where the true closure CANNOT be brute-force evaluated on the candidate set, so a certified controller has non-vacuous value — i.e., a genuinely non-enumerable de-novo generator over a continuous molecular manifold, and prove the analytic certificate bites where re-scoring is impossible. But this re-opens the σ-profile→molecule inverse problem the proposal was built to sidestep, so it is a different (harder, GPU-scale) project, not a patch. Absent that, there is no version that escapes both enumeration-dominance and the active-subspace prior art.

critiques.scooping_justification: The headline deliverable (families of real solvents at a matched thermodynamic activity, designed directly on COSMO-SAC/-RS) is the mature COSMO-CAMD field: COSMO-CAMD (Zhou/Bardow, Sci. Eng. Sci. 2016), Rx-COSMO-CAMD and Rx-COSMO-CAMPD (Gertig/Leonhard/Bardow 2019-2020), and TST+COSMO-SAC reaction-solvent design (2019) all generate real solvent candidates hitting thermodynamic targets, de-novo and multi-objective (harder than retrieval over 1432 VT-2005 molecules). Null-space-as-design-freedom is standard (NPN null-space inverse design, arXiv 2510.01608). Active subspaces for generative molecular design (arXiv 2405.00202) exists (though it targets VAE-parameter uncertainty, not the closure Jacobian). Property-guided diffusion/flow (PropMolFlow 2505.21469, DiffGui/Nat Commun 2025, KGDiff) owns 'diverse molecules at a target property'. The ONLY unscooped sliver is a per-molecule analytic (Taylor-remainder/Hessian) error certificate on a controlled step -- a genuine gap in the diffusion/GFlowNet literature, but a trivial second-order bound available for free from any differentiable map: a methods footnote, not a program.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The load-bearing head-to-head is rigged into a tautology. The premise is that you OWN an exact, autodiffable closure; fitting a learned surrogate to that same function and then showing the exact Jacobian step beats it compares the true map against a deliberately-crippled approximation of itself -- 'exact beats learned' is guaranteed, not discovered. No practitioner uses a learned controller when the differentiable closure is in hand, and the certificate the argument leans on is only computable in exactly the regime where the learned controller is pointless. The one legitimate reason a learned generator exists (amortized O(1) sampling / de-novo novelty beyond the fixed 1432-molecule library) is the comparison the proposal avoids -- and it is the one the physics side plausibly loses. Compounding this, the author's own kill-switch (cosine(learned grad, j) > 0.98) is likely to fire: the measured rank-1 local Jacobian (participation ratio 1.0) means ln gamma is dominated by a single direction, so a global surrogate gradient aligns tightly with j and 'closure curvature explains the gap' collapses. What remains is scooped by COSMO-CAMD (the artifact) or is a Jacobian-geometry/active-subspace claim in disguise (the curvature finding).
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Kill the rigged exact-local-vs-learned-global contest entirely and instead pit the physics controller against an amortized generator (GFlowNet / conditional flow) on a metric where the learned side has a real reason to win -- on-target accuracy AND validity at a FIXED compute budget, or de-novo coverage beyond the 1432-molecule VT-2005 library -- so the physics side genuinely risks losing. Absent a comparison the physics can lose, there is no scientific claim, only a demo.

direction.title: Physics-Certified Iso-Property Design Manifolds: turning the rank-1 COSMO-SAC null space into a training-free, machine-precision molecular generator (and a metamorphic surrogate test that falls out for free)
direction.one_liner: Walk the EXACT level set of the differentiable COSMO-SAC closure to emit maximally-diverse, machine-precision iso-property molecules with no learned generator and no optimization loop -- the closure's rank-1 structure hands you a closed-form "hold-the-property, vary-everything-else" controller, and the certified set doubles as a behavioral test that catches a compensating surrogate.
direction.the_idea:
The dead diagnostic result -- COSMO-SAC's forward map is rank-1 in the sigma-profile (participation ratio 1.0, measured) -- is the ENABLING PREMISE here, not the deliverable. Because the closure is differentiable, cheap, and rank-1, its level set {sigma : gamma(sigma)=y*} is a codimension-1 manifold whose local tangent is the ~50-dim null space of J = d ln gamma / d sigma. I traverse that level set GLOBALLY by a retraction walk: take a step in the local null space, then correct back onto the exact level set with a single Newton step along the 1-D row space (rank-1 makes the correction a scalar -- essentially free). This produces hundreds of sigma-profiles all satisfying |gamma(sigma) - y*| < 1e-6 verified by the REAL closure (not a surrogate), then snaps each to its nearest real molecule in VT-2005. The artifact is a training-free generator of physics-CERTIFIED iso-property molecule sets.

Three falsifiable sharpenings take it past the trivial "the forward map is many-to-one so there are many preimages": (S1 global reach) does the local rank-1 null space integrate into a large, connected iso-manifold, or does the level set pinch shut under nonlinearity within a tiny excursion? (S2 realizability) does the iso-manifold in abstract sigma-space non-trivially intersect the thin manifold of sigma-profiles that real molecules actually realize -- i.e., is the "49 dimensions of freedom" chemical or a numerical fiction of treating sigma as a free vector? (S3 named control) rank-1 means there is a SINGLE universal property dial and the null space encodes a specific, readable chemical trade-off (shift H-bond-donor sigma-region area against nonpolar sigma-region area at constant gamma) -- a design RULE, not just samples.

Compass payoff ("make it real / read it out"): the certified-iso set is a behavioral probe of the learned SigmaProfileHead->CosmoSacLayer TGNN. A surrogate that captured real closure structure MUST predict the whole set iso-property; a compensating imitation breaks along exactly the null directions the physics says are flat, and the pattern of the break LOCALIZES which sigma-features the imitation illegitimately keys on. Generation is both the deliverable and the readout.
direction.why_generative_not_diagnostic: Three ways it refuses the Jacobian-rank/identifiability collapse that killed the prior two programs. (1) The rank is already MEASURED and is an input, not the question; the deliverable is a produced set of real, physically-certified iso-property molecules plus a closed-form controller -- a design object you hand to a chemist, not a scalar about a latent. (2) The open questions are constructive, not spectral: does the level set have GLOBAL reach (S1) and does it INTERSECT realizable chemistry (S2)? Neither is answerable by looking at singular values -- both require actually walking the manifold and hitting real molecules, and both can fail even though the rank is exactly 1. (3) The surrogate test is behavioral/metamorphic, not an identifiable-dim measurement: we never compute the learned model's Jacobian or count its singular values; we feed it physics-constructed inputs and check an invariance of its OUTPUTS. The metamorphic relation is SYNTHESIZED from a discovered continuous invariance of the specific closure, which is categorically different from measuring alignment of two null spaces.
direction.constructive_artifact: A training-free "IsoDesign" controller: given the in-repo differentiable COSMO-SAC closure and a target activity/solubility y*, it returns (a) a set of hundreds of sigma-profiles on the exact level set (machine-precision iso-property, verified by the real closure), (b) their nearest real VT-2005 molecules with a certified-diversity report (range of H-bond vs nonpolar sigma-area spanned at constant gamma), and (c) the explicit 1-D universal "property dial" direction plus a basis for the property-preserving design subspace. No generative network is trained; the generator IS linear algebra on the closure Jacobian plus a scalar retraction. Secondary artifact: a metamorphic test suite -- the certified-iso sets as invariance assertions any learned solubility surrogate must satisfy, with a per-sigma-bin sensitivity map that reads out where a failing surrogate is compensating.
direction.novel_sliver_vs_scooped: HONEST prior art: (i) metamorphic testing of scientific ML surrogates -- Domain-Validity-Gated MT (arXiv 2606.17529), HOMRS (2107.04863) -- but these derive relations from A PRIORI symmetries (equivariance, conservation, scaling) and are testing-only, never a generator. (ii) Differentiable-simulator inverse design with diversity rewards (Allen et al. 2022, "Physical Design using Differentiable Learned Simulators"; latent-flow chemical-space navigation, 2405.03987) -- but these run an OPTIMIZATION LOOP against an APPROXIMATE learned predictor, so "iso-property" is only approximate and diversity can be diversity-in-prediction-error. (iii) Disentangled/controllable molecular generation (E(3)-equivariant WAEs, AAAI'25 34071; physics-constrained VAEs, 2009.13878) -- but the factorization is LEARNED in a latent space, i.e. exactly the Locatello-2019 ill-posed regime. The remaining novel sliver, standing at the intersection of all three: a TRAINING-FREE, closed-form null-space retraction on an EXACT thermodynamic closure that yields machine-precision CERTIFIED diversity (iso-property is ground truth, not a surrogate opinion), where the disentangled control/diversity split is given exactly by the physics rather than learned, AND the same construction synthesizes metamorphic relations from a DISCOVERED continuous invariance (not an assumed symmetry group) that double as a compensation-localizing surrogate test. I have found no work that (a) uses a differentiable closure's exact level set as a generator, (b) claims certified rather than predicted iso-property diversity, or (c) turns the discovered invariance into both a design manifold and a surrogate metamorphic relation.
direction.minimal_viable_experiment: All on MacBook (CPU/MPS); no cluster. Reuse CosmoSacLayer (src/tgnn_solv/layers.py:1452), VT-2005 sigma-profiles, and the measured rank-1 fact. (1) Pick a solute profile p0, fixed solvent, y* = ln gamma_inf(p0). Build the retraction walk: null-space step of J = d ln gamma/d sigma, scalar Newton correction back to the level set; generate M~500 profiles, VERIFY |ln gamma - y*| < 1e-6 through the exact closure. (2) S1: record max excursion (sigma-feature range / path length) before retraction stops converging. FALSIFY if excursions are tiny (level set pinches immediately). (3) S2 -- the make-or-break: for each generated profile, nearest-VT-2005 distance; count DISTINCT real scaffolds within tolerance tau of the iso-manifold. BASELINE: property-matched library retrieval -- random VT-2005 molecules whose EXACT gamma_inf is within the same tau of y*. GO iff the null-space walk surfaces chemically more diverse / more numerous iso-property real molecules than matched retrieval finds; if retrieval matches it, the manifold machinery adds nothing (honest partial-null). (4) S3: check whether the null basis loads on interpretable sigma-regions (H-bond vs nonpolar) -- report the constant-gamma trade-off curve. (5) Compass test: push the certified-iso molecule graphs through the trained SigmaProfileHead->CosmoSacLayer TGNN; measure predicted-gamma DISPERSION across the set. DECISIVE: near-zero dispersion => surrogate respects the physics invariance (real structure); large dispersion => imitation, and the per-bin sensitivity map localizes the shortcut. Every gate has a crisp falsifier; the whole thing is hours of CPU.
direction.biggest_risk: REALIZABILITY collapse (S2) is the honest analog of the dead rank-1 result and the make-or-break: the ~49-dim null space lives in abstract sigma-vector space, but if every null-direction excursion leaves the manifold of profiles that real molecules realize within epsilon, the "design freedom" is a numerical fiction and the generator returns unphysical profiles with no real molecules attached -- direction dead. (MVE step 3 tests this first and cheaply, before any surrogate work.) Secondary risk -- the identifiability-reduction critique: a reviewer can frame "certified-iso design set" as merely sampling the non-identifiable preimage, and the surrogate test as measuring null-space alignment. Mitigation is framing-with-teeth: the primary deliverable is the set of REAL molecules and a usable controller (a design artifact, indisputably generative), the surrogate half is behavioral/metamorphic (outputs under constructed inputs, never the learned Jacobian), and the live scientific questions (global reach, realizability) are provably NOT rank statements since they can fail at fixed rank 1. Tertiary risk -- scoop erosion: if differentiable-simulator inverse-design work already reports machine-precision iso-property via level-set projection, the sliver narrows to the certified-diversity + metamorphic-readout fusion; a focused citation check on Allen 2022 and follow-ons is needed before writing.

critiques.lens: IS IT REALLY GENERATIVE, OR RANK IN DISGUISE?
critiques.scooping_justification: Every load-bearing component is named prior art. (1) The 'control subspace (row space) vs property-preserving diversity subspace (null space)' controller is verbatim Constantine's active/inactive-subspace decomposition of the Jacobian, whose defining use is 'perturb inactive variables to leave the output unchanged' — generative use does not de-rank it. (2) The 'null-space step + scalar Newton correction back to the level set' retraction walk is Henderson predictor-corrector continuation of an implicitly-defined k-manifold (multifario; 'Multiple Parameter Continuation: Computing Implicitly Defined k-Manifolds'). (3) Iso-property / property-geometry-preserving molecular generation: Property-Isometric VAEs (arXiv 2509.14287) and differentiable inverse design to target property (arXiv 2607.02219). (4) The surrogate metamorphic half is squarely inside Domain-Validity-Gated Metamorphic Testing of Scientific ML Surrogates (arXiv 2606.17529, the candidate's own cite) and HOMRS — and that literature's known open problem (domain-of-validity ambiguity of a failed relation) is exactly this candidate's realizability failure mode. The claimed novel sliver (certified-diversity + metamorphic fusion) sits in the intersection but collapses under the certified-vs-real dilemma below.
critiques.fatal_flaw: Certified-vs-real dilemma plus retrieval dominance. The machine-precision certification |gamma - y*|<1e-6 holds only for abstract free sigma-vectors; snapping to a real VT-2005 molecule breaks it (the real molecule's true gamma is not y*), so you get certified-but-unphysical OR real-but-uncertified, never the advertised 'certified iso-property REAL molecules.' And because the closure is cheap and exact, the honest deliverable (real iso-property molecules) is weakly dominated by exhaustive exact-closure library filtering — the candidate's own MVE step-3 baseline — which finds every real iso-property molecule the continuation walk can reach and more. The generative machinery adds nothing on the deliverable that matters. The compass payoff (per-sigma-bin readout of where a surrogate compensates) is a null-space-alignment/sensitivity probe — spectral identifiability in disguise, the exact burned ground — and is both dominated by direct surrogate-vs-closure evaluation and confounded by the realizability gap (domain-of-validity ambiguity). The one genuinely non-rank question, S2 realizability, is the honest analog of the dead rank-1 result and is expected to fail.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Abandon the free-sigma-space generator and the post-hoc 'snap to nearest molecule' step; move the entire construction into discrete graph/synthesis space. Project the closure's null space onto the tangent of realizable, synthesizable graph edits BEFORE walking, so certification and realizability are enforced jointly rather than sequentially — yielding a training-free, physics-derived iso-gamma molecular EDIT operator / certified synthetic route that exhaustive library retrieval cannot produce. This converts the fatal realizability question from a post-hoc failure into a built-in constraint and gives a deliverable retrieval cannot match. Even so it likely remains a domain tool, not a top-ML result.

critiques.lens: SCOOPING + FEASIBILITY + NON-TRIVIALITY — is the novel part more than "the forward map is many-to-one, so many solutions"; is the decisive test cheap on MacBook/T4 reusing the in-repo differentiable COSMO-SAC; and is the ceiling real after web-checking generative/inverse-design, active-subspace, and metamorphic-testing prior art.
critiques.scooping_justification: Scooped on all three axes by named prior art. CONCEPT: "Freedom of Design in Chemical Compound Space" (von Lilienfeld/DiStasio, Chem. Sci. 2023, d3sc03598k) already introduces iso-property "freedom of design," proves molecular properties are weakly correlated, and enumerates manifolds of distinct molecules sharing targeted properties — this is precisely the S2/S3 payoff (design-freedom + iso-property real-molecule sets). METHOD: the "null-space step + scalar Newton correction retraction walk" is textbook predictor-corrector numerical continuation on a solution manifold (Allgower-Georg), and a named "predictor-corrector inverse design scheme" already exists for property-targeted design (ScienceDirect S1003632624666720, 2024); property-level-set traversal generation exists via latent flows (arXiv 2603.26889) and STONED-SELFIES. DECOMPOSITION: the "single universal property dial (row space) + large property-preserving null space" is exactly active subspaces (Constantine), already applied to generative molecular design (arXiv 2405.00202). TEST: the surrogate-invariance half is Domain-Validity-Gated Metamorphic Testing of SciML surrogates (arXiv 2606.17529, already cited in the proposal). The claimed novel sliver (certified diversity + discovered-invariance-as-MR) does not survive: the "certified" adjective fails at the molecule-snap step, and the MR half is the named MT work.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The certification evaporates at the molecule-snap step. The retraction walk verifies iso-property to 1e-6 only for ABSTRACT free σ-vectors; the deliverable is REAL molecules, but realizable σ-profiles are a thin/sparse set the continuous codim-1 manifold generically misses, so the nearest VT-2005 molecule re-evaluated through the real closure is NOT iso-property. The flagship "certified iso-property real molecules" is therefore unsound precisely where it claims exactness (this is the proposal's own S2 "realizability collapse," which it flags as a risk but which is actually load-bearing and predicted to fail — it is the honest analog of the already-dead rank-1 result). Repairing it (constraining the walk to the realizable manifold) requires a learned manifold and reintroduces approximate iso-property → Locatello-2019 disentanglement, the other burned ground. Compounding this: the "~49 dims of design freedom" is just one scalar constraint on a ~50-vector (trivial many-to-one); rank-1 only cheapens the Newton step, it does not create the freedom; and the surviving solid content (control-vs-diversity split, the property dial) is active subspaces — it reduces to rank on the exact axis declared burned.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Abandon the "certified molecule generator" and the design-freedom dimension count (both scooped/unsound), and keep only the one kernel that is neither rank nor trivially many-to-one: promote the closure's exact null direction to a DISCOVERED, falsifiable structure-property TRADE-OFF LAW — the constant-γ exchange rate between H-bond-donor σ-region area and nonpolar σ-region area — and validate it empirically against real iso-γ VT-2005 molecules (equation-discovery-of-a-physical-rule, SINDy/AI-Feynman-adjacent but derived-not-fit). This sidesteps the snap-certification flaw (it is a claim about a curve, not about certifying individual synthesized molecules), and it is generative-of-knowledge rather than a preimage-sampling or identifiability statement. Even then it must be demonstrated to say something "Freedom of Design" (Chem Sci 2023) did not, so a focused differentiation check against that paper is mandatory before writing.

direction.title: The Closure Counterfactual Engine: manufacturing physically-exact solubility counterfactuals to test and instill real structure
direction.one_liner: Turn the frozen differentiable COSMO-SAC closure into an exact counterfactual-label factory — sample its iso-gamma manifold and cross-solvent control directions to MANUFACTURE physically-labeled molecular counterfactuals no dataset contains, then (a) score know-vs-imitate as whether a model reproduces them under extrapolation and (b) train on them to convert an imitator into a knower.
direction.the_idea: The rank-1 closure fact is fatal for interpretation but generative gold as a SUPERVISION SOURCE. At any real molecule's sigma-profile p, autodiff through the frozen differentiable COSMO-SAC gives, for free and exactly (w.r.t. the closure): (i) the ~(D-1)-dim iso-gamma tangent in a solvent S (directions that provably leave ln gamma_inf(S) invariant), and (ii) because gamma_inf in a DIFFERENT solvent S' is a non-collinear rank-1 direction, an equivariance/control direction that changes solubility in S' while holding S. Take small steps along these, project back to a realizable molecule (nearest-realizable sigma-profile / RDKit-decodable variant), and you MANUFACTURE two kinds of labeled counterfactual pairs that experiments and datasets do NOT contain: iso-solubility structural variants and single-solvent-perturbed variants, each with a KNOWN, closure-exact target. This is not walking a manifold to enumerate a many-to-one preimage (trivial, scooped); the deliverable is the exact counterfactual LABELS — the thing you would otherwise need to synthesize and measure molecules to get. Two uses. GENERATIVE TEST (his own definition, 'a model knows iff it generates correct behavior under counterfactuals it never saw'): feed the manufactured pairs to a black-box DirectGNN and to the physics TGNNSolv at EXTRAPOLATIVE conditions (target gammas / solvent-temperature combos outside the training envelope); the generative-extrapolation score = fraction of counterfactuals where the model's response matches the closure's exact prediction. An imitator's learned invariances are training correlations that break off-envelope; a knower's survive. CONSTRUCTIVE PAYOFF (the sign-flip, 'MAKE it real'): fine-tune the black box with a counterfactual-consistency penalty on the manufactured pairs (invariant along the iso-manifold, equivariant along the control direction) and measure whether extrapolation MAE improves — the closure's useless-for-interpretation null space becomes a free, exact, infinite counterfactual data engine that de-imitates a second model.
direction.why_generative_not_diagnostic: The deliverables are produced objects, not measurements: (1) a counterfactual data engine, (2) concrete sets of generated realizable molecules (iso-solubility isosteres and single-property-perturbed variants), (3) a fine-tuned model whose extrapolation behavior is measurably changed. The know-vs-imitate readout is the BEHAVIOR OF GENERATED SAMPLES under intervention at conditions never seen — exactly the operational 'parrots die on extrapolation' definition — not the singular-value spectrum of any Jacobian. The rank-1 fact is USED (rank-1 per solvent makes the iso-manifold clean and the control direction a single sharp vector; multi-solvent stacking supplies the equivariance knob to manufacture the harder counterfactuals) but never REPORTED as a rank or identifiable-dimension.
direction.constructive_artifact: A closure-derived counterfactual data engine: input any real molecule, output (a) a set of distinct realizable molecules predicted iso-soluble across a designed solvent/temperature panel, and (b) matched variants that move one target solubility while holding another — every pair carrying a closure-exact label. Plus the two products that engine enables: a generative-extrapolation know-vs-imitate score computed on those manufactured molecules, and a de-imitated (counterfactual-consistency-fine-tuned) DirectGNN with measured extrapolation gain.
direction.novel_sliver_vs_scooped: Named prior art (searched): Aumentado-Armstrong et al. geometric disentanglement (walk the leading/null right-singular vectors of a LEARNED generator's Jacobian); OroJaR / spectral disentanglement regularizers; physics-informed disentanglement VAE (arXiv 2506.13658, partitions latent into physics-params + data-driven, adversarial); 'Disentanglement as Identifiable Pushforward Factorisation' (2410.22559, the burned identifiability neighborhood); inverse sigma-profile-from-solubility and SMILES->sigma transformer surrogates; CoPhy counterfactual physics benchmark; OOD substructure-invariance molecular representation learning. What is genuinely new and survives: in every disentanglement/counterfactual-world-model prior, invariances are only as real as a LEARNED decoder, so they cannot serve as ground truth. Here the decoder is a VALIDATED thermodynamic closure, so the manufactured invariances/equivariances are exact LABELS, and the novel act is using them as an extrapolation ORACLE to (i) manufacture counterfactual SUPERVISION pairs and (ii) DE-IMITATE a separate black-box model. The label-manufacturing + de-imitation loop is the sliver — not null-space walking (scooped), not inverse design (scooped), not identifiability (burned).
direction.minimal_viable_experiment: Reuse CosmoSacLayer + VT-2005 sigma profiles. (1) ~50 real molecules; at each p, autodiff dln gamma/dp in K solvents; build iso-tangent and cross-solvent control directions; take small steps; project to nearest realizable sigma-profile. FALSIFY-1 (engine validity): re-run walked profiles through an INDEPENDENT COSMO-SAC implementation (public reference / different parametrization) and, where available, held-out experimental gamma_inf; require iso-set gamma spread < eps and control-set gamma tracking target with R^2 > 0.9. If manifold steps do NOT preserve gamma under an independent implementation, the 'exact counterfactual' claim is dead. (2) FALSIFY-2 (know-vs-imitate payoff): score trained TGNNSolv vs DirectGNN on the manufactured pairs at extrapolative conditions; predict physics-model counterfactual consistency survives while black-box consistency drops off-envelope. If DirectGNN matches the closure counterfactuals as well as TGNNSolv, the signal is null and the direction is falsified. (3) Constructive (T4, if 1-2 pass): fine-tune DirectGNN with the counterfactual-consistency penalty; require significant scaffold-test extrapolation MAE gain vs a matched augmentation-free control. All three fit a MacBook + one T4.
direction.biggest_risk: Closure-exact is not nature-exact: manufactured labels inherit COSMO-SAC's own ~0.5-1 log bias, so 'physically exact' honestly means 'closure-consistent'; if the closure is wrong the engine injects its bias into the de-imitation step (mitigate by validating manufactured pairs against experimental gamma_inf and framing the score as closure-consistency, not truth). Second, the realizability projection (manifold point -> real molecule) is the technical crux and, if it becomes free generation, collapses back into generic inverse molecular design (scooped) — the defense is to stay in small neighborhoods of real anchors so projection is cheap and the value lives in the exact labels, not in navigating far. Third, null result: if DirectGNN already extrapolates on these counterfactuals, there is no imitation gap to expose or cure — which is itself a clean, publishable answer to the compass. It does NOT reduce to Jacobian rank because the score and the deliverable are computed on generated realizable molecules under extrapolation including the equivariance direction, quantities no rank/identifiable-dim measurement can produce.

critiques.lens: IS IT REALLY GENERATIVE, OR RANK IN DISGUISE? Verdict: it is genuinely constructive (deliverable is a trained model, not a singular-value count), so it does NOT die by rank-collapse like the two prior programs. But the generative framing is largely cosmetic: strip the iso-gamma manifold dressing and the honest content is 'sample/distill from a differentiable closure', heavily scooped. It dies by scooping + a rigged diagnostic, not by identifiability.
critiques.scooping_justification: The operative content — use a differentiable physical closure as an exact-label teacher to generate consistency/invariance-regularized supervision that improves molecular-property extrapolation — recombines mature lines: counterfactual G-invariance from single environments for OOD (Mouli & Ribeiro, ICLR 2021); regularizing for invariance/equivariance to augmentation (Benton & Finzi 2020; 'Regularising for invariance to data augmentation' 2022); teacher-simulator/physics distillation and QM-assisted extrapolation for small-data molecular properties (npj Comput. Mater. 2023); differentiable SMILES->sigma-profile->COSMO-SAC surrogates (ScienceDirect S2772508122000072); counterfactual truthfulness for molecular property prediction (arXiv 2504.02606); Filtered-CoPhy counterfactual physics. The genuine sliver — decoder is a validated closure so invariances are EXACT not learned — is real but modest: if the closure is cheap and differentiable you can label ANY point directly (no manifold walk), and 'exact w.r.t. closure' inherits COSMO-SAC's 0.5-1 log bias, so it is not exact w.r.t. nature.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The marquee know-vs-imitate test is confounded to the point of tautology: the repo's TGNNSolv can run the cosmo_sac activity model, i.e. it literally contains the closure, so 'physics model reproduces closure counterfactuals better than black-box DirectGNN' is baked in, not a discovery about real structure. The constructive half reduces to physics-simulator distillation/augmentation (scooped), and 'closure-consistency' is not truth — a model perfectly consistent with COSMO-SAC counterfactuals can still be wrong by COSMO-SAC's bias, so 'knowing' collapses to 'imitating COSMO-SAC specifically.' Compounding this, the sigma-profile->realizable-molecule bridge needed to feed graph-input models is either impossible (stay in sigma-space) or is inverse design (scooped) that destroys the exact-label claim.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Drop the closure-as-oracle and the physics-vs-blackbox comparison; instead validate manufactured counterfactual targets against HELD-OUT EXPERIMENTAL gamma_inf and test whether closure-derived consistency augmentation improves extrapolation MAE on REAL measured data, benchmarked against a matched plain closure-label-distillation control. That isolates whether the counterfactual-pair structure adds anything beyond simulator distillation and grounds 'knowing' in nature rather than closure self-consistency — but also demotes the idea to a clean augmentation ablation.

critiques.scooping_justification: The honest version is physics-teacher distillation, and both the method and its chemistry instance are scooped. Method: Sobolev training / Jacobian-matching knowledge distillation from a differentiable teacher (Czarnecki et al. 2017 'Sobolev Training for Neural Networks'; gradient-matching KD, e.g. arXiv 2301.12006). Domain: ML models trained on COSMO-RS/COSMO-SAC-generated activity coefficients and predicted sigma-profiles are an active subfield — transformer-CNN sigma-profile predictors feeding COSMO-SAC screening (link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11705-026-2625-y), hybrid COSMO-RS+ML solubility (S0263876224004428), ML gamma_inf on 34k+ COSMO-derived points. The candidate's scooping list names GFlowNets/diffusion/disentanglement/CoPhy but omits the true nearest neighbor: mechanistic-simulator-as-teacher synthetic supervision. The 'validated closure gives exact labels vs learned decoder' distinction does not rescue novelty because that IS the COSMO-teacher paradigm.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The closure is cheap to query (differentiable, in-repo) — so the iso-gamma manifold and cross-solvent control directions (null space and row space of the Jacobian) add nothing over directly evaluating the teacher on any realizable molecule. The whole 'counterfactual engine' collapses to physics-teacher distillation (COSMO-SAC-as-teacher + Sobolev/Jacobian distillation), which is scooped. Compounding: the know-vs-imitate test is circular because TGNNSolv contains the CosmoSacLayer (it IS the closure), and de-imitation trains the student toward COSMO-SAC's 0.5-1 log bias, i.e. 'make it closure-biased', not 'make it real'.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Move the label oracle off the cheap closure to a regime where the invariant/equivariant directions are genuinely NOT free to query, so the geometry earns its keep: either (a) use experimental gamma_inf as the target so 'make it real' is real (trading exactness for truth), or (b) target an expensive forward simulator whose gradients are cheap but forward evaluations costly, making Sobolev/manifold supervision non-redundant — and use a third-party model as the student so the test stops being circular.

direction.title: Compression Recovers the Knob: an exact-closure–disentangled MINIMAL generator of σ-profiles, where the physics is handed the one property axis for free and MDL is tested to recover it
direction.one_liner: Build the minimal-DOF generative model of realizable COSMO-SAC σ-profiles, then test whether compressing to that minimum FORCES the single property-carrying coordinate (the rank-1 closure direction) to emerge unsupervised — turning the fatal 49-dim null space into a property-preserving diversity generator, validated by generating novel iso-solubility σ-profiles that recover experimentally-known iso-γ pairs.
direction.the_idea: The dead diagnostic result — the σ→lnγ closure is rank-1 (participation ratio 1.0, verified in reports/RESULTS_grounding_budget_t05) — is repurposed as the exact, analytic, zero-label separation of the latent into ONE property-control direction (row space) and a large property-PRESERVING subspace (null space). The generative construction has three moving parts. (1) MINIMALITY: learn a low-DOF generator (small β-VAE or RealNVP flow) of the 1433 real VT-2005 σ-profiles (simplex-valued, ~51 bins, already in repo) — the fewest effective dimensions that reproduce realizable σ-profiles to physical tolerance. This is the MDL/compression object: the intrinsic dimension of the realizable-σ-profile manifold. (2) EMERGENCE (the scientific claim): train the generator WITHOUT any property label or closure, then ask — does compression alone force the closure's property axis to become (near) a single latent coordinate? MDL-as-understanding predicts yes: the property-carrying mode is the physically dominant axis of variation, so the compression-optimal code must spend one coordinate on it. (3) CONSTRUCTION (the deliverable): compose the decoder with the exact differentiable COSMO-SAC; autodiff gives the property gradient in latent space (rank-1), whose complement — intersected with the LEARNED realizable manifold — is a property-preserving diversity controller. Traverse it to generate diverse, novel, on-manifold 'solubility-isosteres': σ-profiles at a fixed activity coefficient, retrievable to real molecules. The minimal generator IS the learned law of σ-profile space; the closure hands it, exactly and for free, the disentangled axis that disentanglement normally cannot get (Locatello impossibility).
direction.why_generative_not_diagnostic: The rank-1 Jacobian is the INPUT (already measured, taken as free), not the claim. Every falsifiable claim is a statement about the DATA DISTRIBUTION of realizable σ-profiles and a CONSTRUCTED generator over it — none is computable from the Jacobian spectrum. The deliverable is a controller that PRODUCES novel σ-profiles at a set property and MANIPULATES property by moving one coordinate; the emergence gate is run generatively (fix a coordinate, sample the rest, measure property spread under the exact closure — not a cosine-similarity readout). A rank number cannot generate a molecule set nor be falsified by chemistry recovery. Two systems with identical rank-1 Jacobians but different realizable manifolds give opposite answers to minimality, emergence, and iso-γ recovery — so the content lives entirely off the Jacobian spectrum.
direction.constructive_artifact: A closure-disentangled minimal generator of σ-profiles: a small flow/VAE over the realizable σ-profile manifold whose coordinates are split by the EXACT COSMO-SAC Jacobian into 1 property-control knob + (d_intrinsic−1) property-preserving diversity knobs. Usage: (a) generate diverse novel iso-property σ-profile sets ('solubility-isosteres') at a target activity coefficient, with retrieval to real VT-2005 molecules; (b) retarget solubility by moving exactly one coordinate while structure diversity is dialed by the rest — a physics-derived disentangled controller with zero property labels needed to define the axis.
direction.novel_sliver_vs_scooped: SCOOPED/adjacent, honestly: Large Property Models (RSC Faraday D4FD00113C, 2025) compress the PROPERTY space, not the structure manifold, and don't use a closure null space. Physics-informed novelty generators (arXiv 2510.23181) and STONED/SELFIES maximize structural diversity but rely on a LOSSY learned property predictor, so iso-property is only approximate. Conceptual-segment σ-profile generation (ie503829b) is rule-based forward construction, no learned manifold or property control. Latent-traversals-as-potential-flows (2304.12944) and local-eigenprojection disentanglement already argue dominant variation aligns with single factors — but for LEARNED, not physics-exact, axes. Locatello 2019 says unsupervised disentanglement needs inductive bias. THE REMAINING SLIVER: the inductive bias is an EXACT differentiable thermodynamic closure that hands the property-preserving subspace analytically and label-free (guaranteeing iso-property by construction, not by a predictor), COMBINED with the falsifiable, non-obvious finding that MDL compression of the realizable σ-profile manifold spontaneously RECOVERS that same axis — an ML-for-thermodynamics emergence result validated against experimental iso-γ∞ chemistry, not a generic disentanglement demo.
direction.minimal_viable_experiment: All cheap; reuses the in-repo differentiable COSMO-SAC + 1433 VT-2005 σ-profiles + γ∞ labels. Step A (minimality gate, CPU minutes): intrinsic dim of σ-profiles via PCA scree + TwoNN/MLE. Compute lnγ∞ in water for all profiles via the differentiable closure → free property labels. Step B (T4 or MPS, minutes): train a small β-VAE/RealNVP on σ-profiles, latent dim ≈ intrinsic dim, WITHOUT property. Step C: autodiff lnγ through the decoder → 1-dim latent property gradient (rank-1 by the measured fact); complement = diversity subspace. Step D (emergence gate, generative): fix the top-loading latent coordinate, sample the rest, measure lnγ spread under the exact closure; repeat fixing a RANDOM coordinate as control. Step E (constructive payoff + chemistry validation): from a seed molecule traverse the diversity subspace to generate iso-property novel σ-profiles; retrieve nearest real VT-2005 molecules; cross-check against experimental γ∞ labels. FALSIFICATION: Kill-1 intrinsic dim ≳20 (no minimal generator → compression story dead); Kill-2 fixing best coordinate leaves lnγ spread ≈ fixing a random coordinate (compression does NOT force the physics knob to emerge → downgrades to hand-injected controller); Kill-3 generated iso-property neighbors have experimental γ∞ no closer to the seed than distance-matched random neighbors (on-manifold generation isn't capturing real chemistry).
direction.biggest_risk: (1) Reduction to 'conditional generation with a physics constraint' / trivial many-to-one: mitigated by exactness (analytic label-free axis, guaranteed iso-property) and by the emergence claim being a falsifiable scientific finding, not an engineering trick — but if a reviewer accepts approximate iso-property from a learned predictor as equivalent, the exactness edge narrows. (2) The emergence gate (Step D) could be read as a disentanglement metric in disguise (diagnostic-flavored) and even if it passes may be seen as re-confirming known 'dominant-axis' traversal results — the defense is that the axis is physics-exact and the payoff/validation is experimental iso-γ chemistry, not a metric. (3) Practical: σ-profile → molecule is itself non-unique, so the honest deliverable may live in σ-profile space with retrieval (not de novo molecule synthesis); and if the realizable σ-profile manifold turns out high-dimensional (Kill-1), the whole compression framing collapses — this is the single most likely way it dies and should be checked first, in Step A, before any generator is trained.

critiques.lens: IS IT REALLY GENERATIVE, OR RANK IN DISGUISE?
critiques.scooping_justification: The load-bearing pieces are each covered by mature prior art. (1) The "constructive controller" — property-control = row space, diversity = null space of the closure Jacobian — is verbatim Constantine's ACTIVE SUBSPACES (2014-15): gradient of a scalar output defines the active/inactive split; the inactive subspace IS the "diversity knobs." Repurposing it generatively adds nothing spectral-novel. (2) "Iso-property generation by moving in the null space" is the trivial many-to-one the mandate explicitly warned against, and as engineering it is already served by STONED-SELFIES / matched-molecular-pairs / scaffold-hopping and by GFlowNets (diverse candidates at fixed reward) — the proposal itself concedes these plus Large Property Models (RSC 2025) and physics-informed novelty generators (arXiv 2510.23181). (3) The one non-rank claim — "unsupervised MDL compression RECOVERS the physics axis as a single latent coordinate" — is the central question of the disentanglement field: Locatello et al. 2019 (impossibility without inductive bias) says it generically fails, and where a dominant learned axis DOES align with a factor it is already argued by β-TCVAE/Burgess-style compression-disentanglement and latent-traversal-as-potential-flow (2304.12944). The remaining sliver (the inductive bias being an EXACT differentiable thermodynamic closure) is real but thin, and the emergence half is the fragile, likely-to-fail part (see fatal_flaw), so what robustly survives is the scooped/burned material.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The candidate welds a burned-ground artifact to a fragile-and-scooped science claim, and the weld fails at a repo-grounded prediction. The "constructive deliverable" (property-preserving diversity subspace = the ~49/51 null space of the measured rank-1 Jacobian) is exactly active subspaces + the trivial many-to-one — moving in the null space keeps lnγ fixed BY DEFINITION, not by discovery; that is disqualified per the mandate. The only escape is the emergence claim (Kill-2): that MDL compression spontaneously spends one latent coordinate on the closure axis. But the repo says the rank-1 sensitivity is HB-BIN-LOCALIZED (~2 bins; "shape-only participation 1.01"), whereas the dominant modes of variation across 1433 σ-profiles are broad polarity/area/scale features. A compression-optimal code will spend its top coordinates on the high-variance polarity axes, NOT on a 2-bin HB direction — so emergence most likely FAILS, leaving only the hand-injected null-space controller (= rank). And in the lucky case it passes, it reduces to the known β-VAE "dominant axis aligns with dominant factor" result, measured by a disentanglement metric (diagnostic in disguise). Either branch collapses: fail → active subspaces; pass → known disentanglement/alignment. Neither is a top-ML generative result.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Kill the "compression recovers the knob" emergence law (Locatello-fragile, and its rigorous form is a spectral alignment claim) and stop deriving diversity from a single closure's null space (that is active subspaces). Instead make the deliverable a MULTI-CLOSURE constructive win that cannot be read off any one Jacobian spectrum: generate σ-profiles that are provably iso-property under closure A (water) while DELIBERATELY retargeted under closure B (a second solvent), then retrieve real VT-2005 molecule pairs and validate against held-out experimental γ∞ in BOTH solvents. The falsifiable, off-spectrum content is whether the learned realizable manifold actually CONTAINS such doubly-constrained solutions and whether they map to real chemistry — a produced, experimentally-checkable molecule set, judged on chemistry recovery versus STONED/MMP baselines, not on an emergence metric. (Caveat: guard against this collapsing back to "intersection of two null spaces," which the prior causal-intervention program already showed fails — the novelty must live in the manifold+experimental-recovery, not the subspace algebra.)

critiques.scooping_justification: Three independent prior-art collisions. (1) The control/diversity split IS Constantine's active subspaces: for the scalar map sigma->lngamma the 1-D 'property-control' direction is the 1-D active subspace and the 49-D 'diversity' space is its inactive complement — active-subspace decomposition verbatim, restricted to a manifold. (2) The novel emergence claim (MDL compression spontaneously puts the physical property on one latent coordinate) is the already-published 'emergent physical generative factors in latent space' result: 'From Physics to Representation' (arXiv 2606.14791) reports reconstruction inducing latents that track physical factors (frequency at MI 1.73; amplitude on the top PCA component) — i.e. the dominant-physical-factor-aligns-with-a-principal-axis finding, plus Locatello 2019 impossibility as the framing. (3) The generative deliverable is populated: property-guided / iso-property molecular generation (VNFlow, J. Cheminformatics 2025; MoFlow; MolHF) and rule-based sigma-profile construction (Conceptual Segment, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. ie503829b). No collision-free sliver remains.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The controlled property is a single scalar (lngamma_inf), so the '1 control knob + 49 diversity knobs' split is not a discovery — it is the 1-D active subspace plus level set of a scalar map, i.e. the trivial many-to-one ('a differentiable scalar has a gradient and a codim-1 level set') dressed as a generative controller, which the mandate disqualifies as an active-subspace/Jacobian-rank reduction. The one genuinely non-trivial claim (compression recovers the axis) is a disentanglement-alignment MEASUREMENT — the burned diagnostic ground — and is already published for physical generative factors. So the two halves are, respectively, trivial+active-subspace and diagnostic+scooped.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Delete the emergence/MDL claim entirely (diagnostic, scooped) and stop calling the split novel (it is active subspaces). Recast the ONLY defensible edge — exactness — as a falsifiable head-to-head CHEMISTRY claim: generate iso-gamma isosteres by traversing the physics-exact null space vs. by a learned-predictor-guided flow, retrieve both to real VT-2005 molecules, and show the exact-closure set holds measured experimental gamma_inf constant to within lab error strictly better than the predictor-guided set. That converts many-to-one into a quantitative measurement claim off the active-subspace/diagnostic ground — still modest, but honest and not scooped.

direction.title: The Closure Proposer: amortized generative discovery of a missing activity-coefficient term, adjudicated by out-of-system transfer against a black-box compensator
direction.one_liner: Train a simulator-in-the-loop amortized posterior over closed-form closure terms of the in-repo differentiable COSMO-SAC (each term a functional of the sigma-profile it already consumes), emit a calibrated distribution of candidate missing-physics terms on real gamma-infinity residuals, and turn "real physics vs. compensating imitation" into a constructive head-to-head: the shipped closed-form term must transfer to held-out solvent systems and be corroborated by single-component data where a matched-capacity black-box correction cannot.
direction.the_idea:
The compass question "did the model learn real structure or a compensating imitation?" has a constructive dual for a physics model with a known deficiency: a *missing closure term* is precisely real structure that a black box currently fakes by soaking residuals into its null space. COSMO-SAC is empirically rank-1 in the sigma-profile, so a flexible correction has an enormous space to hide compensation in — which is why an in-distribution residual fit tells you nothing about whether physics was captured.

Deliverable: an amortized "closure proposer." Define a grammar of candidate free-energy correction terms g(.) that are *functionals of the sigma-profile p(sigma) and T* — the same physical descriptor COSMO-SAC already uses (HB-region integrals with saturating nonlinearities, dispersion as atom-type-weighted sigma-moments, misfit reweightings, temperature factors). Simulator-in-the-loop training (neural posterior estimation): sample a term from the grammar, drop it into the differentiable COSMO-SAC, generate synthetic gamma-infinity across VT-2005 sigma-profiles, and train a set-transformer to invert (system-residual dataset -> posterior over grammar terms). Once trained, it is queried cheaply on *real* gamma-infinity residuals to emit a ranked, calibrated, possibly multi-modal posterior over missing terms.

The generation IS the test. Take the top posterior modes, refit only their coefficients on TRAIN solvent systems, and pit the resulting closed-form term against a matched-capacity black-box MLP residual correction (the scooped "COSMO-SAC-ML" recipe) on HELD-OUT systems and on independent single-component/self-solvation data (the repo's aux-stream lever). A term that transfers out-of-system and is corroborated single-component is discovered physics; if the black-box generalizes strictly better and the posterior stays diffuse, the "real physics" claim is falsified — it was compensation. That adjudication is the compass, instantiated as a produced artifact rather than a measurement.
direction.why_generative_not_diagnostic: The output is a *thing you ship*: a new closed-form free-energy term dropped into CosmoSacLayer, plus a ranked posterior of alternatives. Nothing in the pipeline measures whether a latent is "real"; it constructs the candidate missing physics and validates by asking whether the constructed object generalizes. The decision rule is function-space transfer (held-out-system gamma-infinity RMSE) and physical corroboration (single-component sign/magnitude), never a spectrum. This is the sign-flip of the dead diagnostic program: instead of asking "how many latent directions are identifiable," it asks "can I generate a closed-form term that survives extrapolation" — a generative acceptance criterion.
direction.constructive_artifact: (1) A trained amortized closure proposer: dataset-of-residuals -> calibrated posterior over sigma-profile-functional correction terms. (2) The single best-transferring closed-form term, shipped as code inside the differentiable COSMO-SAC, with fitted coefficients. (3) A "compensation-vs-law" adjudication report per system: does the term beat raw COSMO-SAC OOD, match/beat a matched-capacity black-box at a fraction of the parameters, and get corroborated by single-component data — with the black-box correction as the explicit foil.
direction.novel_sliver_vs_scooped:
SCOOPED, honestly: (a) Bayesian symbolic regression posteriors with UQ over expressions — Guimera-Sales-Pardo Bayesian machine scientist, SMC/RJMCMC SR (RSTA 2024; arXiv 2512.10849), and "Bayesian Inference for Missing Physics" (arXiv 2603.14918) which is literally a posterior over symbolic closure trees; (b) amortized transformer SR that maps a dataset to a distribution over equations (Biggio 2021, Kamienny 2022); (c) UDE missing-physics recovery (Rackauckas) — point estimate, ODE dynamics; (d) hybrid COSMO-SAC-ML that corrects the model with a boosted black-box residual predictor, and the known COSMO-SAC-dsp dispersion / directional-HB hand-built corrections. So "generative distribution over closure terms with uncertainty" as a general method is burned, and "correct COSMO-SAC with ML" is burned.

REMAINING NOVEL SLIVER (narrow but real): amortized simulation-based inference where the inferred object is a *closure of a specific differentiable thermodynamic simulator expressed as a functional of the simulator's own physical descriptor (the sigma-profile)*, trained by pushing sampled closures through that simulator, and accepted not by marginal likelihood or token accuracy but by out-of-*system* transfer plus orthogonal single-component corroboration. No prior work combines (i) simulator-grounded amortization over closures, (ii) a hypothesis grammar locked to the model's own physical coordinate, and (iii) a black-box-compensator head-to-head as the discovery criterion. The Bayesian-SR line scores by likelihood/parsimony on the same data; the novelty here is that the acceptance test lives in a different distribution (new systems, single-component data) — the compass's actual question.
direction.minimal_viable_experiment: Reuse the in-repo differentiable COSMO-SAC + VT-2005 sigma-profiles. Phase A (MacBook CPU/MPS, positive control): implement the sigma-profile-functional grammar; plant a held-out COSMO-SAC-dsp-style dispersion term as ground-truth "missing physics," generate synthetic gamma-infinity, train the set-transformer proposer via NPE, and check it recovers the planted term with a concentrating posterior. Falsify: if it cannot recover a planted term from clean synthetic data, kill the machinery before touching real data. Phase B (T4, hours): query the proposer on REAL gamma-infinity residuals (BigSolDB/VT-2005); refit top-mode coefficients on TRAIN solvent systems; evaluate held-out-SYSTEM gamma-infinity RMSE vs (1) raw COSMO-SAC, (2) matched-capacity black-box MLP residual correction, (3) one-shot PySR point estimate; and test single-component corroboration on a self-solvation probe. PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFICATION: the discovered closed-form term must (a) beat raw COSMO-SAC OOD, (b) match/beat the black-box MLP OOD at far fewer parameters, and (c) predict the right single-component sign/magnitude. If the black-box wins OOD and the posterior stays diffuse under added systems, "discovered real missing physics" is FALSIFIED — honest negative that this system has no cheaply-groundable missing law.
direction.biggest_risk: Two live threats. (1) Collapse to one-shot SR-on-residuals: the amortization + posterior add nothing decisive over a single PySR fit plus a train/test split. Guard: the win condition requires the posterior to be genuinely MULTI-MODAL and calibrated where point-SR silently commits (residual degeneracy under rank-1 is exactly why a distribution, not a point, is the honest object) — if a point estimate transfers just as well, the generative claim dies. (2) Rediscovery, not discovery: the top term merely reproduces the known dispersion (COSMO-SAC-dsp) or directional-HB corrections. Mitigation: those serve as the positive control; the actual discovery bar is a term NOT in the dsp/HB literature that transfers OOD. Secondary risk: many-to-one triviality ("the forward map is many-to-one so of course many terms fit") — neutralized only if out-of-system transfer + single-component corroboration collapse the posterior to few modes; if they don't, the result is an honest null. A subtle disqualification hazard to avoid: seeding candidates in the closure's null space is fine as engineering, but the *claim and test must never rest on counting Jacobian singular values* — keep adjudication in function/transfer space.

critiques.lens: IS IT REALLY GENERATIVE, OR RANK IN DISGUISE?
critiques.scooping_justification: Web-confirmed that the load-bearing machinery is already published. Posterior-over-symbolic-closures: "Bayesian Inference for Missing Physics" (arXiv 2603.14918) is literally a posterior over symbolic closure trees; "Bayesian Symbolic Regression via Posterior Sampling" (RSTA 384:20240590, 2024; arXiv 2512.10849) and "Uncertainty-Aware Symbolic Regression via Bayesian Support Selection" (arXiv 2606.04042) give UQ over expression form. Amortized dataset->distribution-over-equations: Biggio 2021 (NeSymReS), Kamienny 2022; amortized NPE with missing data via BayesFlow (PLOS Comp Biol 2024, PMC11213359). Missing-physics-into-a-simulator: UDE (Rackauckas). Domain corrections: COSMO-SAC-ML residual hybrids and hand-built COSMO-SAC-dsp/directional-HB terms. The candidate's own honest survey matches. The surviving sliver (simulator-grounded amortization + a grammar locked to the simulator's own descriptor + acceptance-in-a-different-distribution) is an application recipe plus standard train/OOD hygiene, not a defensible new mechanism. Only genuinely uncommon element: single-component/self-solvation corroboration used as the law-vs-compensation tiebreaker.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The promised constructive deliverable is improbable, and its improbability is dictated by the very rank fact this program was built to sign-flip. The measured rank-1 closure with participation ratio 1.0 says there is NO low-dimensional, cheaply groundable missing law; so out-of-system transfer will most likely fail for every posterior mode (honest null) and the "shipped closed-form term" never materializes -- or, if anything survives, it rediscovers the known dsp/directional-HB corrections that serve as the positive control.
