Meanwhile the method itself (amortized SBI / Bayesian-SR posteriors over closures with UQ, ML-corrected COSMO-SAC) is scooped. So the realistic outcome is a well-designed negative result produced with machinery that adds little over a single PySR fit plus a train/OOD split. The method escapes the rank trap; the payoff does not. Net contribution collapses to a modest, mostly-null domain finding dressed in scoop-adjacent generative-SBI framing.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Cut the amortized-SBI/posterior machinery (scooped, and a point PySR fit plus a train/OOD split does the same work) and make the ORTHOGONAL single-component/self-solvation corroboration the primary axis -- the one element no scooped work uses. Reframe the deliverable from "discover a new transferable term" (null-predicted) to a reusable, validated "law-vs-compensation" adjudication instrument: pre-commit that a real missing term must be single-component-corroborated, prove the instrument discriminates on a planted-term positive control and on the known-dsp system, and ship the instrument (which is generative-in-spirit and genuinely uncommon) rather than betting the program on discovering a law the physics says is probably not there.

critiques.scooping_justification: The general method is heavily pre-existing on TWO fronts (both admitted by the proposer, and confirmed by search). (1) Generative posterior over closure/equation terms with UQ: "Bayesian Inference for Missing Physics" (arXiv 2603.14918) is literally a posterior over symbolic closure trees for UDE-style missing physics; Bayesian symbolic regression via posterior sampling / RJMCMC and SMC-SR (RSTA 2024/2025, arXiv 2511.14388, NASA NTRS 20250007123) do exactly "distribution over expressions with model-form uncertainty on noisy/scarce data"; amortized dataset->equation-distribution transformers (Biggio 2021, Kamienny 2022) supply the amortization. (2) The black-box foil is itself a shipped 2026 recipe: "Bridging ML and COSMO-SAC" (10.1007/s11705-026-2625-y) optimizes 4 COSMO-SAC params then boosts the gamma-inf residual (MAE 0.944->0.102, R2 0.969) preserving interpretability; "ML-enhanced COSMO-SAC" (S0378381225002055) and physics-embedded ML (PMC12529776) are the same move. So "generative distribution over closures with UQ" and "correct COSMO-SAC with ML" are both burned. The residual novel sliver — amortized SBI whose inferred object is a closure expressed as a functional of the simulator's OWN physical coordinate (the sigma-profile), pushed through the in-repo differentiable COSMO-SAC, and accepted by out-of-SYSTEM transfer plus single-component corroboration rather than in-distribution likelihood — is real but narrow and incremental (a competent recombination + domain application), not a method the field lacks.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The amortized/generative apparatus earns its keep ONLY if real gamma-inf residuals produce a genuinely multi-modal, calibrated posterior over transferable closures — and there is no strong prior that they will. The likely outcome: a one-shot PySR-on-residuals + train/test-system split transfers just as well (killing the amortization+posterior value-add), OR the top mode merely rediscovers COSMO-SAC-dsp/directional-HB (rediscovery, not discovery), OR the recoverable structure sits below the heavy-tailed solubility/gamma-inf label-noise floor. In every branch the result collapses to a scooped COSMO-SAC-ML variant with extra machinery. And the OOD RMSE gate is a losing battleground: a published boosted black-box already hits R2 0.969, so beating it out-of-system with a closed-form term is a high bar the honest falsification may simply fail.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Drop the amortized-SBI framing (scooped, load-bearing only under unproven multi-modality) and make single-component / self-solvation corroboration the PRE-REGISTERED PRIMARY acceptance gate instead of OOD gamma-inf RMSE. Self-solvation is the one axis a matched-capacity black-box residual compensator structurally cannot cheat — it was never fit to it and has no signal there — so requiring the closed-form term to predict the right single-component sign/magnitude turns the compass question ("real physics vs compensating imitation") into a discriminator the scooped COSMO-SAC-ML recipes cannot pass by construction, and one that scores in a genuinely different distribution than any Bayesian-SR competitor.

direction.title: Closure-Clamped Flows: a physically-exact solubility-preserving generator, and the honest test of whether the null space is real design freedom
direction.one_liner: Turn the rank-1 COSMO-SAC closure into a coordinate change that splits a normalizing flow over sigma-profiles into ONE clamped property coordinate (solubility, exact by construction) and ~49 free "style" coordinates -- then answer the empirical question that decides whether the sign-flip is real: is that 49-dim iso-solubility fibre actually populated by valid, diverse molecules, or does realizability collapse it to a point?
direction.the_idea:
The dead diagnostic programs all asked "how many dimensions are identifiable?" -- a rank question. Flip it into machinery, not a measurement. The measured fact is: the differentiable COSMO-SAC closure g: sigma-profile -> ln gamma is locally rank-1 (participation ratio 1.0). So around any profile p, the closure induces an EXACT coordinate split of the 51-dim sigma space: a 1-D property coordinate u = <w(p), .> (the row-space direction w, read straight off the in-repo autodiff Jacobian) and a ~49-D fibre coordinate v (its orthogonal complement) on which ln gamma is invariant to first order.

Build a small normalizing flow (RealNVP) over VT-2005 sigma-profiles, but reparameterize its base coordinates through this closure-induced split: (u, v). Conditioning on a target solubility becomes CLAMPING u to the value the closure requires and letting the flow generate v freely on the fibre. Because the split is rank-1, projecting a raw sample onto the exact iso-property level set is a closed-form rank-1 correction (one Newton step along w, re-linearized 2-3 times to absorb curvature) -- NO classifier guidance, NO iterative constrained-diffusion inner loop, NO guidance-strength hyperparameter. Every generated profile reproduces the closure's activity coefficient to machine tolerance.

The deliverable is a controller: "hold solubility fixed exactly, roam the 49-dim diversity manifold." That is the medicinal-chemistry task of solubility-preserving diversification, done with a hard physical guarantee instead of a soft penalty. The scientific payload is the falsifiable question the generator is built to answer (see experiment): is the fibre realizably populated?
direction.why_generative_not_diagnostic: Nothing in the pipeline measures an identifiable dimension or reports a rank. The rank-1 Jacobian is consumed as a computational device -- it defines the closed-form projection operator that makes conditioning a clamp. The deliverable is a generator that PRODUCES sigma-profiles that did not exist, plus a hard guarantee (exact-on-property) and a benchmark (vs classifier-guided generation). The claim under test -- "does the iso-solubility fibre contain valid, diverse, in-distribution profiles?" -- is a statement about the intersection of the VT-2005 DATA manifold with the closure's level set, i.e. geometry of realizable molecules, NOT about the Jacobian's spectrum (which is already known and fixed). The number 49 is scaffolding for the generator; the finding is whether samples on that scaffold are real. A rank measurement cannot answer that; only generating and validating samples can. That is the exact reason it does not collapse to the burned ground: the earlier programs measured the null space's SIZE; this constructs samples IN it and asks the data whether they are physically real.
direction.constructive_artifact: A "closure-clamped flow": a trained RealNVP over VT-2005 sigma-profiles operating in closure-induced (u, v) coordinates, wrapping the existing differentiable COSMO-SAC layer (src/tgnn_solv/layers.py). API: give a target solubility/ln-gamma, get back an unlimited stream of sigma-profiles all matching it to < 1e-3 log units, with a controllable diversity temperature on the 49-D fibre. Secondary artifact: a validity scorer (VT-2005 density under the flow + a nonneg/normalization/moment check) that labels each generated fibre point realizable-or-not, yielding the first map of "how much of the iso-solubility null space is actually occupiable by valid profiles."
direction.novel_sliver_vs_scooped:
HONEST scooping landscape (web-searchable): (1) Conditional molecular generation to a target property -- cVAE/cGAN/GFlowNet-reward/diffusion-guidance -- fully mature; these hit targets APPROXIMATELY via a learned predictor. (2) Equality-constrained / reflected / manifold-constrained normalizing flows and physics-informed diffusion (2023-2024) -- generate on constraint sets, but via generic iterative projection or soft penalties, constraint treated as a black box. (3) Differentiable-simulator inverse design -- uses the forward model in the loop, but for optimization to a single design, not a diversity-preserving generator. (4) Physics-informed disentanglement / Locatello 2019 impossibility -- disentanglement axes are learned or assumed with soft priors. (5) Preimage/level-set sampling -- the trivial "many-to-one so many solutions."

Remaining novel sliver, stated narrowly: using a MEASURED empirical chemistry closure that happens to be rank-1 to make the property-conditioning projection CLOSED-FORM and non-iterative (a single rank-1 correction, no guidance hyperparameter, no inner optimization) -- and, more importantly, turning the generator into the instrument that empirically resolves whether a large physics-defined null space is a realizable design manifold or an artifact. Against Locatello: the disentangling axis here is neither learned nor assumed -- it is read exactly off the real closure Jacobian, a hard non-heuristic supervision signal, and the property-preserving subspace is deliberately the LARGE one (the regime disentanglement work never targets because it usually wants the few interpretable factors, not the 49 nuisance ones). The sliver is thin and I will not oversell it: each ingredient exists; the combination + the realizability finding is the contribution.
direction.minimal_viable_experiment:
All on MacBook CPU/MPS; no T4 needed for the decisive test. Reuse src/tgnn_solv/layers.py (COSMO-SAC) and results/sigma_profile_artifact/sigma_profiles.csv (~1000+ VT-2005 profiles, 51-dim). Steps: (a) autodiff the closure Jacobian at ~200 anchor profiles, extract row-space w and confirm rank-1 locally (already measured; free re-check). (b) Train a tiny RealNVP on the VT-2005 profiles (minutes on CPU). (c) Implement the rank-1 clamp: sample z, project onto {p : g(p)=target} by 2-3 re-linearized Newton steps along w. (d) Baseline: classifier-guidance conditioning with a learned ln-gamma predictor at matched compute.

TWO falsification criteria, both decisive: (1) EXACTNESS -- closure-clamped samples must reproduce target ln gamma to < 1e-3 log units with zero tuning, while the guidance baseline shows a visible target spread; if the clamp is not tighter and hyperparameter-free, the machinery claim dies. (2) REALIZABILITY (the real science) -- sample the 49-D fibre at fixed target and measure (i) diversity = spread of accepted samples in the fibre, and (ii) validity = fraction that stay in-distribution under the flow density + pass nonneg/normalization/moment checks. Pre-registered kill line: if the in-distribution-valid fraction collapses (fibre effectively 0-1 dimensional -- realizability pins the profile down) then the "49 dims of design freedom" sign-flip is FALSIFIED and I report that the null space is an interpretation artifact, not a design manifold. If instead the valid fibre spans many effective dimensions, the solubility-preserving diversifier is real. Either outcome is a clean, honest result on a laptop.
direction.biggest_risk: The dominant risk is that the interesting content evaporates from both ends. Downward: if the null space is NOT realizably populated (validity collapses), the generator degenerates to near-preimage-of-a-point and the whole thing reduces to the trivial many-to-one observation -- but note this is a real, publishable negative that honestly kills the seed, so the risk is to the narrative, not to the science. Upward/scooping: reviewers can frame closure-clamped conditioning as "just equality-constrained flows with a cheap projection," and the rank-1 closed-form step, while elegant, is a modest engineering delta over generic projection. Second-order: the artifact lives in sigma-profile space, not molecule space (VT-2005 gives no differentiable profile->molecule inverse), so "molecular design freedom" is aspirational -- the honest deliverable is design freedom over an intermediate physical FIELD, and any molecule-level claim would need a separate, harder decoder I do not have. Residual worry it secretly re-imports identifiability: guard by never reporting a dimension count as a result -- only report exact-hit tightness, sampled fibre diversity, and validity fraction, which are properties of generated data, not of the Jacobian.

critiques.lens: Rank-in-disguise where it is load-bearing. The (u,v) coordinate split is literally an active-subspace / Jacobian-rank decomposition (row space vs null space of the rank-1 closure). The clamp is a closed-form projection onto the level set along that single active direction. The ONLY decisive-and-cheap test (exactness) is therefore a construction tautology; the genuinely generative test (fibre realizability) is undecidable with the available tools. The 'generative' dressing is real as code but cosmetic where it would need to escape the burned ground.
critiques.scooping_justification: The pipeline is a stack of mature pieces. Property-conditioned generation via latent normalizing flows with a surrogate predictor: 'Property-Guided Molecular Generation and Optimization via Latent Flows' (arXiv 2603.26889) and E(n)-equivariant / hierarchical molecular NFs (MolGrow, MolHF). Equality-constrained / reflected / manifold-constrained flows and physics-informed diffusion (2023-24) already generate on constraint sets via projection. Differentiable-simulator inverse design already puts the forward model in the loop. The coordinate split itself is Constantine's active subspaces (2015) and Transtrum/Sethna sloppy models. The one distinctive bit -- 'the projection is closed-form because the empirical closure happens to be rank-1' -- is a modest engineering delta on generic equality-constrained flows, and the repo's own adversarial review (reports/REVIEW_grounding_paradox_2026-07-13.md) already suspects the rank-1 closure correction of merely re-fitting a between-solvent mean offset (52 params on ~48 points/fold), which further undercuts leaning on rank-1 as the load-bearing novelty.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The two 'decisive' criteria fail in opposite ways. (1) EXACTNESS is tautological: projecting along the closure's own rank-1 Jacobian direction hits the target ln-gamma to machine precision BY CONSTRUCTION -- it is not a finding, and the guidance baseline being looser is unsurprising. (2) REALIZABILITY, the only real science, is undecidable with the available artifacts: the validity oracle is the flow's OWN density estimated from 1432 profiles in 51-D (circular and badly underpowered for declaring fibre points 'in-distribution'), and there is no differentiable profile->molecule decoder, so a nonneg/normalized/right-moment 'valid sigma-profile on the level set' is exactly the trivial many-to-one preimage -- NOT evidence of molecular design freedom. Strip the undecidable realizability claim and what remains is the active-subspace projection (rank) plus 'the forward map is many-to-one' (trivial). The sign-flip narrative ('49 dims of design freedom') is a nice sentence but cannot be cashed into a molecular claim here.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Move the fibre into MOLECULE space with an INDEPENDENT realizability oracle: compose the differentiable closure through a trained, invertible molecular latent (or a profile->molecule decoder), and judge fibre points by an oracle that is not the generator's own density -- RDKit/synthesizability validity, or held-out membership against real molecules the flow never saw. Only then does 'is the null space real design freedom?' become a falsifiable molecular claim instead of an abstract-field preimage restatement. Absent that decoder, the seed cannot escape the trivial many-to-one observation.

critiques.scooping_justification: The core machinery is substantially anticipated. Physics-Constrained Flow Matching (PCFM, arXiv:2506.04171, 2025) already enforces hard *nonlinear* equality constraints (incl. conservation laws) on pretrained flow models at inference via a Gauss-Newton projection u - Jᵀ(JJᵀ)⁻¹r onto the constraint manifold — the candidate's "closed-form rank-1 Newton step along w" is literally this operator specialized to a rank-1 J. Manifold-Aware Perturbations for Constrained Generative Modeling (arXiv:2601.23151) and Riemannian CNFs (Mathieu & Nickel, NeurIPS 2020) generate on constraint manifolds via projective solvers. The Jacobian-row/null split as disentanglement is anticipated in spirit by Jacobian-SVD disentanglement (OroJaR arXiv:2108.07668; Ramesh et al. Spectral Regularizer arXiv:1812.01161). Conditional-to-target molecular generation (Graph DiT multi-conditional diffusion, MolGrow flow, cVAE/GFlowNet) is mature. What no cited work does: (a) deliberately sample the null-space fibre for diversity at fixed property, (b) characterize *realizability* of that fibre against a data manifold. That surviving sliver is real but thin, and it lives in σ-profile space, not molecule space.
critiques.fatal_flaw: The deliverable is a σ-profile generator with no differentiable σ-profile→molecule inverse, so the headline "solubility-preserving molecular design freedom" is unvalidated at the molecule level — the artifact produces plausible histograms, and its "validity" oracle (the flow's own density) is circular. Meanwhile the machinery it leans on (closed-form hard equality projection on a pretrained flow) is a rank-1 special case of PCFM's already-published Gauss-Newton projection, so the only truly novel payload is the fibre-realizability characterization — which is both predictable (σ-profile constraints almost certainly leave the ~49-dim non-HB complement richly populated, so the kill-line rarely fires) and quietly identifiability-flavored: "effective dimensions of the valid fibre" is a dimension-of-realizable-set measurement wearing a generative costume. Elegant, honest, but thin and impact-capped for a standalone program.
critiques.one_change_that_would_upgrade: Lift it out of σ-profile space: validate a handful of clamped-fibre samples as *real molecules* — either couple the flow to an approximate/retrieval σ-profile→molecule decoder, or recompute σ-profiles from an independent QM/COSMO calculation for candidate molecules and show the recomputed lnγ still hits the clamp. That converts "aspirational molecular design freedom" into a demonstrated one and gives the realizability claim a physical (not self-referential) validity oracle — the difference between a laptop demo and a genuine standalone contribution.
